name: Nuvio MovieBoxPro Companion
description: A private, self-hosted browser companion that lets Nuvio request fresh playback links through a user's own authorized MovieBoxPro account.

notes.text: After installation, run 'nuvio-companion setup-url' in the LXC console and open the private link to finish setup.
A free TMDb API key and an authorized MovieBoxPro account are required. Login occurs on MovieBoxPro's official site through the private browser desktop.
Keep ports 43110 and 6080 on a trusted LAN or private VPN. Never publish them directly to the internet.
